title: My mallworld
content: Hi I’ve only heard of this recently and thought sharing would be fun. I’ve dreamt of my mall world for years and years. I never forget these dreams either because of how reoccurring this place is. The mall I always dreamt of was Palisades Mall. I rememeber being 13 and going there for the first time in awe as it was the exact mall I dreamt of so many times. Whenever I dreamt of it I would be stuck in an escalator or on one of the highest floors having to jump to another level to my parents. These dreams always played on my fear of hights, getting separated from my parents, and stuck on the escalator. One such dream I remember I was with my parents and sister Christmas shopping. My sister and I had gotten lost and separated from my parents. Now there had been about 5 or 6 escaltors each going up and down. And through out the dream they had shifted kind of like how the stairwells do in Harry Potter. Of course I get up to the tallest floor and I had to jump from the top floor to my mum on the second floor. I had missed and woke up in a panic. As I got older the place seemed to expand. In high school and middle school, the school was added on. I remember running through the halls to navigate to the highschool. This highschool was a jumble of my actual highschool and one that I had never seen before. One part of a dream I remember so vividly was having been in the mall, opening a door to this orange stairway that was in my irl highschool. Years later in another dream of this place, the same thing happend and I remember telling the person I was with I knew where I was and that this was just the highschool attachted to the mall. We were running from a monster or somthing. And I was so confident when I opened the door and it led to the mall. The very last time I went to this Mallworld place, I had reached what I knew to be the top of the mall. (I was 18 or 19) It was so vivid. We started in the mall-me and my family, then somthing had happened that lead to me and someone close to me being chased. We had gone through the highschool, the mint halls filled with empty windows and mahogany doors to the orange staircase that lead to a fourth or fith floor. Then we ended up in this massive movie theatre, we weren’t there for long before we ended up at the top where there was a full airport. That was where my parents and sister were waiting for me. We had reached the top floor and I remember them saying this was one of the best airports in the country and how impressive it was that it was on the roof of the mall. The place was so white and sunny. There was so many people there coming and going too. I find it strange how these dreams stuck with me for all these years. I’ve always been able to have vivid dreams. I’m curious what you all think of this mall.
